description: Edit a post's content or media before it goes out — works on a draft or a still-pending scheduled post, not one that's already posting or done. Call list_scheduled_posts first to get a valid id. To change the scheduled time instead of the content, delete and recreate the post.

firstComment.description: New first comment posted immediately after publishing (Facebook and Instagram only)

id.description: The scheduled post id, from list_scheduled_posts

mediaUrl.description: New publicly accessible image or video URL to attach

name: update_post
